title: Aligning Schedules at Institutes of Higher Learning with Pre-employment Programmes and School Holidays
what_it_is: Aligning Schedules at Institutes of Higher Learning with Pre-employment Programmes and School Holidays

sections.label: Polytechnic and IHL calendars
sections.summary: Polytechnic calendars consider enrolment timing, with no plans to align them with primary and secondary schools; CET and PET schedules are broadly aligned, while short courses are flexible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The Polytechnic calendar also takes into consideration when students enroll into their courses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: There are currently no plans to align the Polytechnic academic calendars with Primary and Secondary schools.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The academic schedules in IHLs for Continuing Education and Training (CET) programmes leading to full qualifications, such as part-time diploma and degree programmes, are broadly aligned with Pre-Employment Training (PET) programmes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Short modular courses and Workforce Skills Qualifications, however, are designed with a more flexible programme schedule and do not necessarily align with the academic calendars for the longer programmes.

sections.label: December holidays and assessments
sections.summary: A speaker asks whether mid-semestral assessments in December could be removed and December holidays blocked off, noting different parts of society have different needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Or if they are teaching CET students like I do, we do not get the December holidays as a whole.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: So, will the Ministry consider removal of mid semestral assessments, both in terms of exams as well as these graded assignments within the December period?

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Second, would the Ministry consider blocking off the December holidays completely to allow staff and students to recuperate and consolidate at the very least and, of course, spend time with their families?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: I think different parts of our society will have different needs, be it Primary schools, Preschools, Secondary schools, post-Secondary schools, Universities and adult learners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: It may also not necessarily be the best idea for all of us to say that all of them should take their breaks together and align it as such.

sections.label: IHL internship opportunities
sections.summary: Internships are a critical part of the IHL learning environment, and IHLs have been urged to move away from rigid term time and break time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: One of the very critical parts of the learning environment for our IHLs has to do with their internship opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: And in fact, in more recent times, I have also urged our IHLs to move away from what we rigidly think of as term time and break time, because that may not be necessarily the best way for us to fit the internship opportunities into the working environment that is required by the participating companies.

sections.label: Aligning school calendars
sections.summary: Adult learners and different courses have different needs and internship opportunities, so aligning all school calendars from preschool to IHLs on one consideration would not be possible or wise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: All the more so for adult learners in the continuing education and training programmes, that they would have different needs, different courses would have different internship opportunities and we have to take all this into account.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, it would not be very possible nor very wise for us to work on the premise of one single consideration and, therefore, try to align all our school calendars from preschool, all the way to IHLs, according to only one consideration.
